name: Foot Fetish Fortress VolTitan Vs The Jundoh Empire Vol.3
detailed_description:
Voltitan Vs. The Jundoh Empire is a third person shooter visual novel hybrid with nine action packed episodes where the story and difficulty depends on the player's priorities in the 3d level.

Three factions, six playable characters, and the fate of one world in your hands in the third exciting volume of FFF Voltitan Vs. The Jundoh Empire. As Voltitan gains the second phoenix stone the Jundoh Empire have formed a new dastardly plot against the Deodragon. Will the mighty Voltitan and his allies be up to the challenge or will the empire Triumph? 

For the first time in the Voltitan Vs The Jundoh series the the player can experience the adventure through the lense of Voltitan, trusted his allies or enemies experiencing new twists and turns along the way  each with a unique perspective in the narrative and playstyle that can affect the narrative If you aren't interested in the foot focused elements provided in Voltitan, Kingmera, or J-Buster's timelines worry not because Daigemer, Linkman, and Twilight Zeta's routes provide a more traditional super robot/tokusatsu experience:

  • Church of the Deodragon: 

    Continue the quest for the phoenix stones with the mighty Voltitan as his champion learns to master Voltitan's destructive powers. Blast and purify enemies in your path while defending the peaceful Empire of Sol-Kada.

  • Fusion Fighter Daigemer Tricrimson:

    Assist Voltitan with the mighty Daigemer Tricrimson and uncover the mysteries of the Jundoh Empire. While Daigemer lacks Voltitan's powers he is three super robots in one as he ventures beyond Sol-Kada.

  • Trials of Linkman:

    Witness Linkman's quest for revenge as he foils the Jundoh Empire's ambitions cross paths with the agent of chaos Twilight Zeta. He's the fastest of the three heroes but has incredible speed and agilty to aid Daigemer as they venture beyond Sol-Kadia.

  • Heel of the Empire:

    lead the Jundoh Empire to glory with Kingmera while dealing with cunning usupers, and meddling rivals that try to hinder the empire's quest for order. Learn the chaos and comedy of running an intergalactic empire through the lense of the Emperor and Empress of the Jundoh Empire during their scheduled invasions of Sol-Kadia.

  • Gargabeast Gladiatrix J-Buster:

    challenge the Deodragon with the amazing J-Buster in this thrilling magical girl adventure. While she lacks Voltitan's fire power she has the strength of three Gargabeasts in one in her quest to defeat Voltitan.

  • Double Devil Twilight Zeta:
    Uphold the Empire's order in the shadows with the mysterious enforcer Twlight Zeta while avoiding Voltitan's detection. With the power of the Moon and Sun on his side he's an unpredictible force to be reckoned with.

Whether you want to be the savior or conqurorer of planet Feeternia choice is yours.

Gameplay features:

  • Multiple endings and branching paths depending on the success,failures and decisions made  during the level's gameplay.

  • Six playable characters with unique playstyles and narrative tones.

  • Unlockable gallary from player's defeated visual novel segments.
